statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41568 is a symlink-swap race during `docker cp` mount setup in the Moby daemon, requiring a running dockerd performing container filesystem copies. The dhi/tkn image installs the tekton-cli package, which ships only the tkn client binary at /usr/bin/tkn. It contains no Docker daemon and no Docker CLI plugin loader. github.com/docker/docker is a module-graph dependency only: `go tool nm` on the shipped binary reports zero symbols from any github.com/docker/docker package, including daemon, api, client, pkg/archive and pkg/homedir. The only github.com/docker/cli code linked into the binary is the credential-configuration subtree (cli/config with its configfile, credentials, memorystore and types packages), reached through go-containerregistry's authn keychain when `tkn bundle` resolves registry credentials; cli-plugins contributes zero symbols. The vulnerable code is therefore not present in the image. The scanner matches the resolved module version against the advisory range regardless of reachability, so this statement is required to clear the false positive.

CVE-2026-42306 affects Docker Engine daemon docker cp mount setup for containers with volume mounts. GitLab Runner and docker-machine vendor github.com/docker/docker for client-side Docker API support and do not run dockerd or perform daemon-side mount setup, so the vulnerable daemon path is not reachable from this image.

CVE-2026-41568 affects Docker Engine daemon docker cp mountpoint creation. GitLab Runner and docker-machine vendor github.com/docker/docker for client-side Docker API support and do not run dockerd or execute daemon-side container root filesystem setup, so the vulnerable daemon path is not reachable from this image.

CVE-2026-41567 affects Docker Engine daemon archive extraction when handling compressed uploads to PUT /containers/{id}/archive. GitLab Runner and docker-machine vendor github.com/docker/docker for client-side Docker API support and do not run dockerd or expose the daemon archive API, so the vulnerable daemon path is not reachable from this image.

grafana/alloy v1.16.1 imports github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible via the legacy pre-rebrand path. The upstream fix lives in github.com/moby/moby/v2 (post-rebrand module split); no higher version exists on the legacy docker/docker import path. A bump requires alloy upstream to migrate its import paths to moby/v2. Reachability of the docker cp archive-extraction code path in alloy's runtime (container metadata and log discovery only) is pending assessment.
